# Svayatta

> Custom software, AI agents and workflow automation for Indian businesses, from a Mumbai studio.

Svayatta is a software and AI studio based in Mumbai, India. We design, build, and support production systems that run core business operations: custom ERPs, offline-first CRMs, AI agents, conversational assistants, and data workflows. We work on fixed milestones with real data and human review at every critical step.

## Services

- Agentic AI Systems: Autonomous agents for multi-agent workflows, tool integrations, and human handoff.
- Conversational AI: WhatsApp and voice assistants for customer booking, queries, and operations.
- Machine Learning & Analytics: Forecasting models, document intelligence, and executive reporting.
- Custom Software & ERP: Local-first and cloud systems for payroll, finance, CRMs, and internal tools.
- Web & Digital Presence: Fast, search-optimised websites, web applications, and digital platforms.
- Content & Growth Marketing: Audience-focused brand positioning, performance content, and video production.

## Products

- CruSam (https://svayatta.in/projects/crusam): Desktop payroll and finance ERP with an embedded AI assistant, deployed in production at Aarti Enterprises.
- Growmont CRM (https://svayatta.in/projects/growmont): Local-first CRM keeping client records, sales pipelines, and follow-ups in sync across desktop and mobile, with offline capability.
- Growmont PMS (https://svayatta.in/projects/growmont-pms): Fund analysis and scoring platform for wealth managers, turning twenty years of mutual fund data into risk metrics and SEBI peer rankings (In development).
